description: A bench built out of a dock pallet and two courses of breeze block, topped with a strip of foam that was upholstery in some other life. The bar across it is a length of scaffold pole, knurled where a thousand hands have worn the galvanising off, and the plates are whatever the basin had spare — cast iron, poured concrete, one truck brake disc with the hub still in it. There is no rack. You get it up off your chest or you roll it onto the floor and everyone hears you do it. Lie down and lift.
name: pallet bench
